items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Gil actually wrote a lot of good instrumental things for me, for Lloyd's band.

ctx.x: So you were doing all the kind of standard Lloyd Price material but-
No, we did more than his material, because Gil actually wrote a lot of good instrumental things for me, for Lloyd's band.
So besides his hits, his hit records, you all did his hit records.
